Definition: a burden; specifically, tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively, an utterance, chiefly a doom, especially singing; mental, desire
BiblicalUsage: n m; 1) load, bearing, tribute, burden, lifting; 1a) load, burden; 1b) lifting, uplifting, that to which the soul lifts itself up; 1c) bearing, carrying; 1d) tribute, that which is carried or brought or borne; 2) utterance, oracle, burden; Massa = "burden"; n pr m; 3) (BDB) a son of Ishmael
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
